decisions.reason: Operator training is cheap to maintain, had its own page from launch, and supports the firm's machine sales, so the option is worth holding even though recent evidence is missing.
The rotary axis accessory was only mentioned on the website, but it complements the core milling machines at low carrying cost, so keeping it open is sensible despite weak and uncertain evidence.
Hybrid additive post-processing is a speculative, uncertain market where value has not yet resolved, so the cheap option is kept for now though it is the most likely candidate for abandonment.
The high-speed CNC milling machine is close to the firm's core business and had a dedicated page, so the investment is largely sunk and continued commitment is justified.
The automatic tool change system had a dedicated page and is integral to the machine portfolio, so its value is likely realized through machine sales and it is kept.
